sentences.text: Neeraj vs State Of U.P. on 21 March, 2023

Author: Saurabh Shyam Shamshery
Bench: Saurabh Shyam Shamshery
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 76
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 56119 of 2022
Applicant :- Neeraj

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Virendra Singh Parmar,Sudhir Kumar Singh Parmar
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Shyam Shamshery,J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2.

The applicant has approached this Court by way of filing the present Criminal Misc. Bail Application seeking enlargement on bail in Case Crime No.210 of 2019, Sessions Trial No.284 of 2019, under Sections 498A, 304B, 120B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station-Khutar, District-Shahjahanpur after rejection of his Bail Application vide order dated 25.11.2022 passed by learned Incharge Sessions Judge, Shahjahanpur.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant after arguing for sometime fairly submitted that presently trial is at the fag end and evidence of Investigating Officer is underway and prayed that a direction be passed to conclude the trial expeditiously.
4. Learned A.G.A. has no objection if the trial is expedited.

Neeraj vs State Of U.P. on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76672493/
1

5. Considering the aforesaid submissions and taking note of status of trial, learned Trial Court is directed to conclude the trial expeditiously, preferably within a period of eight weeks from today if there is no legal impediment.
6. With the aforesaid direction, this bail application is disposed of.

Order Date:-21.3.2023 SB  Neeraj vs State Of U.P. on 21 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/76672493/
